description: 12 steps at shulker boxes facing up and north, one with a stone over its lid and one under a hopper: a window (type 20, container.shulkerBox), iron and planks shift-clicked in and a shulker box refused, its lid events (on opening and closing only), a comparator reading it, the boxes kept shut by the stone over the lid and by the hopper but not by a stone beside the lid, the filled box broken in survival dropping one item, which, picked up and placed again, opens with the same contents; Circuit and both official servers give identical output
